text: 【周末要闻汇总】国常会研究算力网建设有关工作；三部门印发《数字乡村高质量发展行动计划》；国家对成品油价格实施调控；编造、传播“税率调整”虚假信息，四人被证监会处罚；美国8月CPI数据出炉，美联储加息预期升温；霍尔木兹传来新消息，伊朗与海湾六国下周会晤；消息称也门胡塞武装已完成对曼德海峡的控制；多家券商收紧个人程序化交易接入。
text_en: [Weekend News Roundup] The State Council executive meeting studied work related to the construction of a computing power network; three departments issued the "Action Plan for High-Quality Development of Digital Villages"; the state implemented regulation of refined oil prices; four people were penalized by the CSRC for fabricating and spreading false information about "tax rate adjustments"; U.S. August CPI data were released, raising expectations of a Fed rate hike; new news came from Hormuz, with Iran and six Gulf countries to meet next week; reports said Yemen's Houthi armed forces have completed control of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait; multiple brokerages tightened access to personal programmatic trading.
